fields.statement: QA at 95fee8aca with a binary built from the head: `rhiza guide build` prints the builder checklist (acceptance commands, `rhiza ship generate`, `rhiza render`, fold changes in, a Checks: block with exit codes above the trailers) and `rhiza workflow describe build --json` shows the builder prompt naming the pre-handoff checklist. In a scratch git repo, `rhiza ship generate` exited 0 both unset (nothing to generate) and with rhiza.ship.generate set (staged the changed file), and `rhiza render` exited 0. A commit made from the guide's example message parses with `git interpret-trailers --parse` to exactly Change/Actor/Leaf/Co-Authored-By, so the Checks: block is not read as trailers; `rhiza check` on this branch claims its Checks:-carrying commits. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide ./internal/workflow pass.

QA at 95fee8aca with a binary built from the head: `rhiza guide review` prints the Fixer section's checklist (reproduce the findings, `rhiza ship generate`, `rhiza render`, a Checks: block with exit codes); builtin review.toml's fixer and builtin ship-change.toml's ci-fix, gate-fix, gate-fix-merge, conflict-fix and conflict-fix-landed prompts all name the Checks: block. Caveat: in this repo `rhiza workflow describe ship-change` resolves to the repo layer .rhiza/workflows/ship-change.toml, which shadows the builtin and lacks the new text, so Rhiza's own ci-fix/gate-fix/conflict-fix fixers do not get it (filed as a discovered-from draft change set). go test -trimpath ./internal/guide ./internal/workflow pass.

QA at 95fee8aca with a binary built from the head: `rhiza guide build`'s Verifier section says to re-run every command in the commit's Checks: block and every acceptance command, and that a different exit code or no Checks: block is a finding naming the command. Re-running the Checks: commands of this branch's 5f8bfd112 in scope (go test -trimpath ./internal/guide ./internal/workflow) exited 0 as reported. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide passes.
